relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: HIV-1)-infected leukocytes not only secrete matrix metalloproteinases (MMP)-2 and MMP-9 that impair the BBB

relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: Small-fiber neuropathy mediated by excessive activation of sodium channels (Nav1.7)

key_findings: Review proposing that non-neuronal cells (immune cells, glia) drive nociplastic pain through peripheral and central sensitization and synaptic plasticity.
Hypothesis that viral pre-infection with BBB disruption and immune infiltration may be a prerequisite for NPP.
